_about: Phase 2b integration: the leftovers that the walk of the Russian interface found (strings still in English, the decimal-comma hint, the Language setting). id -> {en, ru, plural?, en_plural?, ctx?, note}, as in phase2b-ui.json. Russian follows notes/i18n/GLOSSARY.md. Read by work/xb/tools/make_ru_table.py; these win over the other tables.

lo.parse.decimal_point.note: parse.js withComma(): added after any Russian parse error when the formula has a comma between two digits (GLOSSARY 2.3, the lead's default). Not shown in English.

lo.arc.start.note: app.js shapeEditor: the arc's first point field (GLOSSARY: lower-case field labels).

lo.arc.through.note: app.js shapeEditor: the arc's middle point field (the arc passes through it).

lo.arc.end.note: app.js shapeEditor: the arc's last point field.

lo.grid.divisions.note: app.js shapeEditor: the Cartesian grid's count field (a count label: «делений: 8»).

lo.grid.circles.note: app.js shapeEditor: the polar grid's circle count.

lo.grid.rays.note: app.js shapeEditor: the polar grid's ray count.

lo.field.set.note: app.js shapeEditor: the region formula field.

lo.field.equation.note: app.js shapeEditor: the curve formula field.

lo.field.label.note: app.js shapeEditor: a point's label field.

lo.zp.zero.note: app.js: the Add-a-zero button of a zeros-and-poles card (GLOSSARY: always «нуль»).

lo.zp.pole.note: app.js: the Add-a-pole button of a zeros-and-poles card.

lo.yes.note: app.js: the guarantees matrix, a lit cell's screen-reader label.

lo.no.note: app.js: the guarantees matrix, an unlit cell's screen-reader label.

lo.gauge.note: app.js right readout: the derivative gauge is drawn scaled by ×k (GLOSSARY: derivative gauge = индикатор производной).

lo.deg.note: app.js: the Polynomial and Rational lamps' qualifier (GLOSSARY: degree = степень).

lo.deg_le.note: app.js: the qualifier when the degree is an upper bound.

lo.audio.running.note: app.js sound popover, the engine line: the AudioContext state («Звук: работает · 48 кГц · 5 мс»).

lo.audio.loading.note: the voice engine while its worklet loads.

lo.audio.worklet.note: the voice engine: the AudioWorklet (a product name).

lo.audio.nodes.note: the voice engine: native Web Audio nodes.

lo.delete.note: app.js: the shape menu's Delete item (the key chip ⌫ stays).

lo.copied.note: app.js: a readout after Copy value.

lo.badge.rational.note: app.js: the guarantees lamp and chip name. The catalog label (funcs.js, the card) stays «Рациональная» (tools/ru_collisions.json).

lo.badge.mobius.note: app.js: the guarantees lamp and chip name. The catalog label (funcs.js, the card) stays «Дробно-линейная», which fits the card.

lo.field.cmd.note: The visible text of the header command field (GLOSSARY: placeholder; DESIGN.md 8.3). #35: the field is Add function (notes/i18n/TERMS.md).

lo.readout.at.note: app.js hoverReadout: the left readout «в точке w 0,5 + 0,3i» while the right plane is hovered and the preimage search is off.
